research_role: first strategy-usefulness test of the accepted MKT-TRND-001 direction representation, without Trend-Breadth combination

economic_hypothesis.mechanism: a positive medium-horizon trend shared across six broad A-share indices may identify a persistent long-equity state, while a nonpositive median direction keeps the strategy in cash
economic_hypothesis.independence: the trigger is only the accepted index-level direction representation and the basket rank is capacity-only; it does not use Industry Diffusion, Low-MAX, breadth, support, candles, or Champion membership
economic_hypothesis.representation_boundary: MKT-TRND-001 established neighboring-horizon representation stability for direction only; this experiment is the first separate usefulness test and does not reinterpret quality, age, transition, strength, or alignment

frozen_strategy.clock: last completed market session of each calendar month, decision at completed close
frozen_strategy.state: median direction_return_60 across the exact six MKT-TRND-001 indices is strictly greater than zero
frozen_strategy.inactive_state: hold cash; no short, hedge, or inverted trade
frozen_strategy.stock_universe: exact causal Cycle-015 daily-feature rows on the month-end; prior-20 average amount is already at least CNY 50m
frozen_strategy.selection: 20 highest prior-20-session average-amount stocks, descending avg_amount20 then symbol; capacity only
frozen_strategy.entry: next legal market-session open; blocked names are not backfilled
frozen_strategy.holding: 20 market sessions from entry to due open, with unchanged QD-010 and legal-fill handling
frozen_strategy.event_capital: minimum of available cash and all pre-entry NAV

sequential_protocol.full_replay: run exact 2018-01-02 through 2023-12-29 only when both gates pass; no rule change

prohibited: alternative index subset, direction horizon, moving-average rule, zero buffer, percentile, month clock, basket size, liquidity window, holding period, capital divisor, or cost
Trend-Breadth, Trend-Volatility, trend-quality, trend-age, trend-transition, strength, alignment, or Champion combination
validation outcome access before every generation requirement passes
OOS, independent-confirmation, production, or live claim
